lines.speaker: Surveyor Michael
lines.text: I don't want to cast a bad light upon anyone, but you can't trust what he says.

lines.speaker: Surveyor Michael
lines.text: His surveys are entirely decided by bribes from stakeholders, he is only influenced by money.

lines.speaker: Surveyor Michael
lines.text: I also quite certainly did not get lost during my survey.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I see… thank you for helping me clear this up.

lines.speaker: Surveyor Michael
lines.text: Of course. Don't hesitate to drop by again. I have lots of tea in reserve.
